notes.title: Regular Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
We've got an exciting update for you this time.
[olist]
[*]New and Improved Tutorial
[list]
[*]Learn how to Right-click on a card to see its information and combination recipes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981353/542bbde96b0ebdeca0ee967a822a7456672b13db.gif[/img]
[*]Learn how to use a card effectively against different monster actions.
[*]Learn how to Combine cards to accumulate a Cell.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981353/d302bbf99601e497cae1bb9bd13260027d9cbd23.gif[/img]
[*]Learn how to Use a Cell and a Skill to remove a specific Cell color, paving the way for transformation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981353/02c26b5836caf0a7432ad46febe73d816c7e0df8.png[/img]
[*]Learn how to Use Gen a Cell potion to transform! (How exciting!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981353/146c7e4998b31652f93bc523cb54e5c2e78049d5.gif[/img]
[/list]
[*]Prop Randomization and Mimic Addition
[list]
[*]Props are now easier to find before reaching the gate, reducing your exploration time.
[*]A new challenge awaits! We've added Mimics based on our dev team's play-testing.
[/list]
[/olist]
[b]
For this update, there is a possibility that players may encounter bugs when playing from their previous save files.

[u]We recommend deleting your old save data and starting a new game to ensure the best experience.[/u]
[/b]
Thank you for your understanding!

tags.feature: Learn how to Right-click on a card to see its information and combination recipes.

Learn how to Use Gen a Cell potion to transform! (How exciting!)
Props are now easier to find before reaching the gate, reducing your exploration time.
A new challenge awaits! We've added Mimics based on our dev team's play-testing.
